purpose: Evaluate monthly production and sales question coverage against the current Feature 141 catalog and generic query pipeline.

cases.question: کگل در آخرین ماه چه مقدار تولید داشته است؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical Companies.Id through a provider-scoped report identity; fail closed if unresolved
cases.period: latest accepted single-month actual; Noavaran ProductSales OutputType=0 when that provider is selected
cases.revision: accepted logical revision only; exclude pending and rejected-older revisions
cases.unit: source quantity unit; do not normalize or combine incompatible units
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source mappings and report revision selection are not compiled

cases.question: مقدار تولید گندله کگهر در شهریور ۱۴۰۵ چقدر بوده؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.productIdentity: company/provider-scoped product key; title matching alone is insufficient
cases.period: explicit Persian calendar month resolved to persisted report interval
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source, product filter, and report-period binding

cases.question: تولید کنسانتره کگل نسبت به ماه قبل چند درصد رشد کرده؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.period: two adjacent single-month actuals with the same provider and report type
cases.revision: accepted logical revision independently selected for each month
cases.unit: units must match across both months
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source, multi-period selection, dimensional validation, and approved growth operator

cases.question: کدام محصولات کگهر در سه ماه اخیر بیشترین رشد تولید را داشته‌اند؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.period: three latest consecutive single-month actual periods
cases.unit: per-product unit must be compatible across all selected periods
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: grouping, ranking, multi-period retrieval, and growth operator

cases.question: فروش ریالی کگل در شهریور ۱۴۰۵ چقدر بوده؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.period: explicit single-month actual; distinguish ProductSales, ServiceSales, and cumulative output types
cases.unit: million IRR in stored line item; preserve source scale
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source, report type/output type, and period filters

cases.question: مقدار فروش گندله کگهر در آخرین گزارش ماهانه چقدر است؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source and product binding

cases.question: نرخ فروش گندله کگهر در مرداد و شهریور ۱۴۰۵ چقدر بوده؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source and time-series projection

cases.question: فروش ریالی کگل در شش ماه گذشته چه روندی داشته؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.period: six consecutive single-month actual periods, one accepted revision each
cases.unit: million IRR in stored line item
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: monthly source and time-series projection; existing specialized trend capability remains authoritative

cases.question: کدام شرکت‌های تولیدکننده گندله بیشترین مقدار فروش را داشته‌اند؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company identity; provider-scoped ExternalCompanyId cannot be globally joined
cases.period: same explicitly selected month and report scope for all companies
cases.revision: accepted logical revision per company and period
cases.unit: compatible quantity units required; otherwise partition or reject
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: category mapping, company fan-out, aggregation, and ranking

cases.question: فروش ماهانه کگل و کگهر را با هم مقایسه کن.
cases.companyIdentity: two separately resolved canonical company identities
cases.period: same requested month range and report scope per company
cases.revision: accepted logical revision per company and period
cases.unit: million IRR for amounts; do not mix amount and quantity
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: multiple company bindings and comparison shape

cases.question: کدام شرکت‌های یک صنعت بیشترین رشد فروش ماهانه را ثبت کرده‌اند؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company identity with reviewed industry association
cases.period: same adjacent single-month actual periods for each company
cases.revision: accepted logical revision per company and period
cases.unit: amount growth only under existing approved definition and compatible periods
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: cross-domain joins, aggregation, and growth calculation; use governed specialized route

cases.question: رشد فروش ماهانه کگل با رشد سود عملیاتی آن چه تفاوتی داشته؟
cases.companyIdentity: same canonical company, separately scoped monthly and financial provider identities
cases.period: monthly periods versus financial statement periods must remain explicit and distinct
cases.revision: monthly accepted revision and financial statement selection policy applied independently
cases.unit: compare growth rates only; do not join raw amount scales
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: multi-source plan, cross-domain period alignment, and comparison compiler

cases.question: آیا رشد تولید کگهر با رشد فروش آن هم‌جهت بوده است؟
cases.companyIdentity: canonical company plus provider-scoped report identity
cases.productIdentity: same company/provider product identity on both measures
cases.unit: production and sales quantities each require internal period compatibility; do not compare their raw units
cases.compilerStatus: unsupported: multi-measure source, time comparison, and dimensional validation
